narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Pidilite Industries has consistently met or exceeded its profitability and volume targets over the past four quarters. Operating within its target EBITDA corridor of 20% to 24%, management delivered standalone EBITDA margins of 23.4% in Q4 FY26 and beat the upper bound in Q1 FY27 reaching 26.4%. Underlying volume growth (UVG) accelerated from 10.3% in Q2 FY26 to 15.3% in Q4 FY26 and maintained a healthy 11.3% in Q1 FY27.

guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (15-May-2026), PDF p. 12 — "As far as we are concerned, at this moment, I would say we have guided a corridor of 20% to 24%."

delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (12-Aug-2026), PDF p. 4 — "EBITDA margins at 26.4% improved by 80 basis points quarter-on-quarter and profit after tax grew by 27.7%."

quarters.commentary: Pidilite surpassed its operating margin guidance band of 20% to 24%, delivering a standalone EBITDA margin of 26.4% due to proactive price increases and operating leverage.

guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (11-Feb-2026), PDF p. 10 — "because for us, the EBITDA corridor which we have shared is 20% to 24%."

delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (15-May-2026), PDF p. 3 — "And EBITDA margin at 23.4% expanded by 280 bps versus same period last year."

quarters.commentary: Management delivered standalone EBITDA margins of 23.4%, landing comfortably within the guided 20% to 24% corridor, alongside strong 15.3% underlying volume growth.

guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (06-Nov-2025), PDF p. 4 — "Sudhanshu Vats: Yes, Sandeep just told you about our VAM numbers, yes, VAM is now below $900."

delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (11-Feb-2026), PDF p. 4 — "Just for information, VAM consumption in the quarter was at about $830 as compared to $884 in the same period last year."

quarters.commentary: Pidilite kept VAM consumption costs down to $830 per tonne, beating its outlook of keeping raw material costs below $900, while maintaining standalone EBITDA margins at 24.5%.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management consistently maintains a conservative profitability corridor of 20% to 24%, proactively taking calibrated price increases during input cost spikes while reinvesting gross margin expansions into A&SP to protect double-digit volume growth.

rejections_detail.quote: But if you look at full year, we are confident that we will be at the upper end of this 20%, 24% range.
